aisteve.screen.main.title: AiSteve Settings
aisteve.screen.main.hint: Configure your AI companion's features and behaviour
aisteve.screen.llm.title: Language Model API
aisteve.screen.llm.hint: Works with any OpenAI-compatible provider (scroll with the mouse wheel)
aisteve.screen.llm.preset_hint: §8Click to cycle presets - fills in the URL and model name
aisteve.screen.perm.title: AI Permissions & Behaviour
aisteve.screen.perm.hint: Configure how your AI companion behaves (scroll with the mouse wheel)
aisteve.screen.perm.autonomy: Autonomy (finds its own things to do)
aisteve.screen.perm.roam: Follow distance: %d blocks (comes back beyond this)
aisteve.screen.perm.narration: Progress narration (says what it's doing, reports back)
aisteve.screen.perm.language.hint: §8It mirrors whichever language a player speaks to it; this is the default
aisteve.screen.cap.title: AI Capabilities
aisteve.screen.cap.hint: Choose which kinds of action the AI may perform (scroll with the mouse wheel)
aisteve.cmd.no_ai: §cThere is no AI companion right now.
aisteve.cmd.no_ai_create: §cNo AI companion yet. Create one with §b/as create <name>§c.
aisteve.cmd.server_only: §cThis command can only be run from the server.
aisteve.cmd.player_only: §cThis can only be used by a player.
aisteve.cmd.no_agent_runtime: §cThis AI does not have the layered agent runtime enabled.
aisteve.cmd.exists: §cThere is already an AI companion: §e%s§c. Remove it first with §b/as remove§c.
aisteve.cmd.create_failed: §cFailed to create the AI companion - check the log.
aisteve.cmd.created:
§aCreated AI companion §e%s§a.
§7· Give it a task: §b/as say <what you want>
§7· Hand it an item: §b/as give§7 (hold it first)
§7· Take items back: §b/as take
aisteve.cmd.removed_extra: §aRemoved AI companion §e%s§a (also cleaned up %d leftover entities)
aisteve.cmd.cleaned_leftovers: §aCleaned up leftover AI entities in the world.
aisteve.cmd.cleanup_done: §aCleaned up %d AI entities (including leftovers from older builds). You can now use §b/as create§a again.
aisteve.cmd.info_none: §7No AI companion right now. Create one with §b/as create <name>§7.
aisteve.cmd.ask_what: §cSay what? For example: §b/as get me some food
aisteve.cmd.bag_full_cannot_give: §cThe AI's inventory is full - cannot give it anything.
aisteve.event.ready: §a[AiSteve] §fAI companion §e%s§f is ready. Give it a task with §b/as <instruction>
aisteve.event.none: §a[AiSteve] §fNo AI companion yet. Create one with §b/as create <name>§f.
aisteve.event.duplicates: §e[AiSteve] §fFound and cleaned up %d duplicate AI companions (this mod supports exactly 1).
